name: atsushiootani
description: concier-chan's kit — Claude Code plugins by atsushiootani, for working with agents day to day.

plugins.name: prompt-timeline
plugins.description: See a day of your own Claude Code work on one page: API-equivalent spend, agent busy time, the hour-by-hour shape, sessions ranked, and the day's moments. Reads only the transcripts on your machine.

plugins.name: ubiqdoc
plugins.description: A local document reader where you drag any phrase and ask the AI on the spot. Answers are written back into the document as popovers, child sections or links, and several questions can run in parallel.
